description: Find local restaurants on the VoiceBit platform, browse their menus, build a cart, and place a pickup or delivery order that you pay for on a secure checkout page.

interface.longDescription:
VoiceBit helps you find and order food from local restaurants on the VoiceBit platform.

Ask for a restaurant or a cuisine, check opening hours and service options, and browse the menu with filters such as category or dietary needs (vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and more). Add items with their sizes and options to a cart, change it as you go, and review a full summary with subtotal, tax and total.

When you are ready, confirm your name, phone number and how you want your food (pickup, delivery, curbside or dine-in, now or scheduled). VoiceBit places the order with the restaurant and gives you a secure checkout link where you pay and, for delivery, enter your address. Card or payment details are never collected in chat.
defaultPrompt: Find a pizza place near me that I can order from.
Show me the pizzas at Big Apple Pizza in Livermore.
Help me order dinner for pickup tonight.

publication.release_notes: Faster, more reliable ordering: restaurant and menu data now come directly from the VoiceBit backend, menu search supports category and dietary filters, and checkout guidance is clearer. Delivery address and fee are handled on the checkout page, and payment details are never asked for in chat. Adds the app icon.
